Website information

PRIVACY & MEDIA.

A straightforward explanation of this site’s features.

Your information

This static website has no contact form, account system or analytics added by this redesign. Calling or emailing opens your chosen phone or email application. Please do not send payment-card details or sensitive personal information by email.

Preferences & hosting

The motion control stores a preference in your browser’s local storage. The site reads local time for a subtle color adjustment and, where supported, reduced-motion, data-saving and battery signals to limit effects. These signals are not sent to a business database by this site. The hosting provider may process ordinary request logs and access or authentication data under its own terms.

External services

Fonts may load from Google Fonts. Directions, Facebook, Yelp, the Wash Club and third-party guides open external services governed by their own privacy policies. No social feed, tracking widget or map embed is loaded automatically.

Google review snapshot

The reviews page reproduces the supplied Google Reviews text snapshot, including critical feedback and owner replies. It is not a live Google feed. Dates are shown as captured, and missing ratings, profile photos and links have not been inferred. Review wording belongs to its respective authors. Links lead to the business’s current Google review listing.

Images & video

The Tom’s logos and mascot were supplied for this redesign. The cinematic vehicle image is AI-generated illustrative artwork, not a photograph of Tom’s premises, staff or a customer’s results. No generated people are presented as Tom’s employees.

Questions

Contact info@tomscarwash.com about this website.
